messages.subject: [Traminer-users] absolute transition matrix
messages.body_plain:
Hi, 

I want to get a transition matrix with absolute frequencies but I can't find any function to achieve that. 

Is it possible to get the absolute number of transitions of each kind, it would be the equivalent of the transition rate matrix (obtained with seqtrate) but with absolute values? 

Thanks, 

Hadrien
